entry_points.text: Boot presets THP policy with warnings; deferred-split scan and debug write parse path or pid ranges under one mutex with bounded reclaim.
Hugetlb boot registers sizes, resolves counts and allocates fault tables; early strings route via central registration with per-node balanced fallback.
Huge VMA lifecycle enters via ops table; atomic fill handles poison, continue and alloc with checks; protection walk validates and reports changes.
Failure handling shakes, unmaps and kills; poison inject needs privilege, valid pfn and filters; pool stores validate and commit guarded values.

exports.text: Aligned huge placement first with generic fallback; moves validate alignment and emptiness; protection invalidates in place then reinstalls.
Split divides locked folios via anon or file paths; collapse thread start and stop match enablement; zero folio released conditionally.
Pool offers cross-size demotion and validated numeric resize; global and per-node totals report free, surplus and reserved.
PMD migration installs swap entries preserving markers; batched reclaim selects huge-aware walkers; folio walk returns pinned folio with lock.
Unpoison, pagemap lookup and initial mm are public with strict guards, range containment and early code, data and break setup.

hazards.text: Concurrent retention aborts zero reclaim without progress; partial init unwinds stages; split maps loss, truncation and ref drift to busy or retry.
Gigantic lacks runtime dissolve and migrate support; growth aborts on signal and surplus races may oversize; malformed counts discard staged state.
Poison paths reread heads and refetch splits under refs; dirty sampled outside locks and atomic walks may skip; vmemmap refuses self-hosted ranges.

invariants.text: Global policy uses exclusive bits for always, madvise or never; defrag selects one of five modes; each anon size is always, inherit or madvise.
Split needs locked large folio, in-range target and splittable verdict with anon or file locking; scans skip unsuitable entries and revalidate.
Zero folio reclaimable only with sole reference; huge means shared zero or large compound; fork shares zero and duplicates anon with rmap.
Fork dup clears child reservation guarantee; regions sum clamped overlaps; early CMA applies only to gigantic when global-only.
Cgroup tracks live, ceiling, peak and breach for normal and reserved with scaled reads and parent-linked per-size counters.
Poison acquisition retries bounded and rejects kernel-owned pages; kill forces on dirty or failure; shmem surplus computed locked, released outside.

locks.text: Zero pointer and anon policy serialize under dedicated locks; thread create and wake serialize under mutex; fault installs hold table lock.
Split holds folio lock plus anon write or file interval with xarray; deferred queue uses irq-safe list with RCU; walk returns with leaf lock.
Global huge spin guards freelists and accounting, never held across alloc or yield; subpool under own lock; resize drops lock for alloc and free.
Unpoison runs under failure mutex; huge poison acquisition under hugetlb spin; demote nests resize mutex outside spin with per-iteration recompute.

state_machines.text: Policy writes move among recognized spellings restarting background on change; startup runs checks, interface, background and shrinker stages.
Deferred isolate moves live entries and requeues on contention, stopping when idle; migration preserves markers into swap and back with dirtying.
Growth absorbs surplus then stages allocations; shrink preserves floor; demotion skips optimized and poisoned; atomic copy falls back outside locks.
Huge poison branches over acquire, retry, filter, free, unmap and state; vmemmap splits then remaps; boot checks, registers and reports.

structs.text: Policy enums order choices from unconditional to disabled; per-CPU tables count by size with summation; reservation modes cover needs through delete.
Top directory groups global controls with per-size objects; hugetlb keeps global, demote and per-node attrs; pool sysctls use restricted mode.
Registry holds count, default index, fixed array, node mask and lists; cmdline pairs strings with callbacks; boot records carry linkage and flags.
Remap walk carries callback, counts and head with tail plus no-flush flags; one page reserved for vmemmap; debug writes capped at 255 bytes.
